description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility and facilitating custom log node chaining.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to facilitate logging with support for log node chaining and various log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates the log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
